thread:
Owen: opened a docs PR to split the big migration into atomic pieces: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Priya: nice, can you add a short changelog blurb per file? helps release notes
Owen: yep added small summaries — also renamed some example SDK snippets for clarity
Kelsey: pinging reviewers, I'm on call for doc approvals today. I can take the SDK snippets
Maria: heads up CI preview failed on the link-check step :( see logs: https://ci.internal/1234
Owen: hmm saw that, it's the generated TOC anchor mismatch. quick fix in place. rerunning preview.
docs-bot: docs-preview started for PR #482
Maria: re-run showed one remaining 404 in /guides/migration#old-endpoint
Owen: I think that's from the legacy example in examples/legacy.md. I'll remove and add redir note
Kelsey: can someone else eyeball the migration language? want to avoid breaking instructions for Dedicated customers
Priya: I can review migration wording tomorrow morning. prefer to merge post-preview and post-approve
Liam: if we want to keep CI green, we should stagger merges. propose: snippets merged first, then migration guide in next window
Kelsey: +1. I'll approve snippets now.
Owen: thanks. Approvals: Kelsey (snippets), Priya (migration). After both approved I'll re-run preview and tag for merge window at 16:00 UTC
Maria: small ask — add an anchor test in CI: `scripts/check-anchors.sh` so future renames fail early
Owen: added to PR: ```bash
./scripts/check-anchors.sh examples/legacy.md
```
docs-bot: docs-preview succeeded for PR #482 :thumbsup:
Priya: left nit comment on migration wording, but otherwise approved
Kelsey: approved
Liam: merging in 30m during low-traffic window. @everyone add a rollback note if anything breaks :eyes:
Owen: will watch logs, thanks all!
